purpose: Setup qualification of an owned headed full Chrome window and advancing submitted WebGL2 content at CDP compositor-surface readback
fixedBackend: Linux native Wayland, hardware ANGLE Vulkan, DPR 1

api.launch: launchOwnedHeadedBrowser({ executablePath, taskRoot, observeWindow }) -> { page, session, evidence, ownership, actualBackend, close }
api.smoke: runHeadedPresentationSmoke({ executablePath, taskRoot, observeWindow }) -> evidence; owns launch and cleanup
api.presentation: proveHeadedPresentation({ page, session, ownership: { targetId, windowId, url, viewport: { width, height } }, smokeId, frameTimeoutMilliseconds?, commandTimeoutMilliseconds? })
api.actualBackend: { display, angleBackend, vulkanVersion, vendor, vendorId, deviceId, deviceDescription, driver, rawRendererStrings }; observed facts, qualify setup only with PASS_SETUP_ONLY and complete cleanup
api.observeWindow: ({ browserPid, browserIdentity: { pid, startTimeTicks }, smokeId, windowId }) -> { browserPid, backend: 'wayland', mapped: true, hidden: false, xwayland: false, size: { width, height }, ...rawOwnedWindowEvidence }; verify the owned process lifetime before and after querying the compositor
api.windowReadiness: waitForOwnedNonceWindow filters exact PID before inspecting titles, observes only owned windows, and polls for mapping within 1800 ms with bounded client reads

prerequisites: Install the repository dependencies using its documented Bun workflow
Provide an existing full Chrome/Chromium ELF binary; package shell wrappers and headless-shell binaries do not qualify
Provide a new writable evidence directory on a workload volume and an active Wayland session
The explicitly selected Hyprland adapter requires hyprctl; other compositors provide observeWindow through the library API
standalone.absentDisplayOrAdapter: Emits a SKIP result with the reason and starts no browser
standalone.unknownOrConflictingEvidence: Emits UNKNOWN_FAILED_SETUP, exits nonzero and preserves failure evidence; do not try another backend
standalone.resourceAccounting: Run through the host's configured browser job queue with a bounded outer deadline
standalone.output: result.json includes actual OS process provenance, executable/profile custody, hardware renderer, compositor window facts, page geometry, submitted challenges, raw PNG frames, compositor timestamps and cleanup

constraints: Raw observed command line and requested argv are independent evidence; original execve argument boundaries remain null
No whitespace in executable, task root or requested flag arguments because rewritten Linux command lines cannot recover argument boundaries
Call close in finally when using the launch API; never share its process, profile or page with another task
All comparison actors and counts retain one qualified display/GPU backend; actual actor custody remains the comparison runner's obligation
Three discrete nonce challenges, no RAF loop, no readPixels, no getImageData and no benchmark acquisition
PNG pixels establish compositor content identity; strictly increasing actual CDP timestamps establish advancement
This proof does not qualify Canvas2D, WebGPU rendering, terminal correctness, throughput or optical latency
Observed native-Wayland/Vulkan incompatibility rejects hardware qualification even when the adapter and Vulkan renderer are physical
CDP screencast content establishes browser compositor-surface readback; native output presentation additionally requires an independently validated native capture
qualificationStatus: The Linux native-Wayland Vulkan recipe is unqualified on Chrome builds reporting incompatible surface transport. The helper rejects that diagnostic; absence of the diagnostic alone does not prove native presentation.
